hero.heading2: We'll help you multiply what it can do.
hero.motto: Show us your business. We'll show you what's possible.
hero.body: You don't need a large team to operate like one. Olcorp Tech uses AI, automation and smart technology to help small businesses save time, reduce repetitive work and accomplish more with the team they already have.
hero.location: Based in Regina, Saskatchewan. Serving businesses province-wide and world-wide.

services.title: Four ways we help your business work smarter
services.subtitle: Whether you need a better online presence, smarter automation, AI-powered workflows or connected business systems, we design, build and manage technology around the way your business actually works.

cards.title: Business Automation & Smart Systems
cards.description: We connect your tools, devices and business systems so they work together automatically. Reduce repetitive manual work, free up staff time and keep your operation running smoothly without constant oversight.

cards.title: AI & Workflow Automation
cards.description: We identify the tasks your team does repeatedly and build AI-powered systems to handle them. From automated customer responses to internal workflow tools, the goal is always the same: save time and improve how your business operates.

cards.title: Websites & SEO
cards.description: We build fast, professional websites and make sure the right customers can find you on Google. Better online visibility means more leads, more calls and more customers walking through your door without spending on ads.

cards.title: Social Media & Digital Growth
cards.description: We manage your social media presence so your business stays active and visible where your customers spend their time. Consistent content, genuine engagement and a clear brand voice that builds trust and generates leads.

why.title: Enterprise-level engineering. Small business scale.
why.subtitle: The Forward Deployed Engineer model was built for companies like Palantir and their largest government clients. We bring the same embedded, hands-on approach to Saskatchewan small businesses.

cta.heading: You don't need to come to us with a technology project.
cta.body: Come to us with your business. Tell us how it works, what takes too much time, where your team does things manually, and where you think you could be doing more. We will identify where technology can help and build a plan around your operation.
cta.location: Based in Regina, Saskatchewan. Serving businesses province-wide and world-wide.

footer.tagline: Your embedded technology partner for business automation, AI, websites, SEO and social media. Built for Saskatchewan small businesses.
